test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence.

Rohan said to Manasi, "I have no rose to give you now."

options.text: Rohan told Manasi that he has no rose to give her then.
Rohan told Manasi that he had no rose to give her then.
Rohan told Manasi that he had had no rose to give her then.
Rohan told Manasi that he had no rose to give her now.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** Rohan told Manasi that he had no rose to give her then.
